# ComprimeFotos.com

> ComprimeFotos is a free online image and PDF toolkit for Spanish-speaking users (Spain and Latin America). All tools process files directly in the browser: nothing is uploaded to a server, no registration is required, no watermark is added. Focus areas: image/PDF compression, background removal, format conversion and photo-size guides for regional requirements.

## Tools

- [Comprimir imágenes](https://comprimefotos.com/tools/comprimir-imagenes): Compress JPG, PNG and WebP images online without visible quality loss; 100% in-browser, no upload, no registration.
- [Comprimir PDF](https://comprimefotos.com/tools/comprimir-pdf): Reduce PDF file size online while keeping text and image quality; works in the browser without account.
- [Quitar fondo](https://comprimefotos.com/tools/quitar-fondo): Remove image backgrounds automatically and in-browser, with a free export without watermark.
- [Imagen a PDF](https://comprimefotos.com/tools/imagen-a-pdf): Convert one or several images into a single PDF document online.
- [Comprimir imágenes WhatsApp](https://comprimefotos.com/tools/comprimir-imagenes-whatsapp): Compress photos to WhatsApp-friendly sizes so they send fast without quality loss.
- [Foto carnet](https://comprimefotos.com/tools/foto-carnet): Generate DNI / passport / visa photo sizes used in Spain and Latin America (3x4, 4x4, 2x2 and more).
- [Redimensionar imagen](https://comprimefotos.com/tools/redimensionar-imagen): Resize images by pixels, percentage or preset sizes online.
- [Redimensionar redes sociales](https://comprimefotos.com/tools/redimensionar-redes-sociales): Get ready-made image sizes for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X and YouTube.
- [Convertir formato](https://comprimefotos.com/tools/convertir-formato): Convert images between JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC and other formats in the browser.
- [PDF a imagen](https://comprimefotos.com/tools/pdf-a-imagen): Convert PDF pages into JPG or PNG images online.
- [Comprimir vídeo](https://comprimefotos.com/tools/comprimir-video): Reduce video file size online without losing visual quality.
- [Imagen a texto](https://comprimefotos.com/tools/imagen-a-texto): Extract text from images with OCR in the browser.
- [Fondo blanco producto](https://comprimefotos.com/tools/fondo-blanco-producto): Make a pure white product-photo background for e-commerce listings.
- [Restaurar fotos antiguas](https://comprimefotos.com/tools/restaurar-fotos-antiguas): Restore old or damaged family photos online.
- [Procesador por lotes](https://comprimefotos.com/tools/procesador-por-lotes): Compress, resize or convert many images at once.
- [Recortar imagen](https://comprimefotos.com/tools/recortar-imagen): Crop images online with free, fixed or preset aspect ratios; no upload, no install.
- [Poner marca de agua](https://comprimefotos.com/tools/poner-marca-de-agua): Add text or image watermarks to photos with adjustable position, size and opacity, rendered in the browser.
- [Añadir texto a foto](https://comprimefotos.com/tools/anadir-texto-foto): Overlay captions and text on images with font, colour and placement controls.
- [Filtros para fotos](https://comprimefotos.com/tools/filtros-para-fotos): Apply vintage, black-and-white, warm, cold and other colour filters to photos in one click.
- [Foto a blanco y negro](https://comprimefotos.com/tools/foto-a-blanco-y-negro): Convert colour photos to black and white or greyscale with adjustable contrast.
- [Hacer collage](https://comprimefotos.com/tools/hacer-collage): Combine several photos into a single grid collage and export it as one image.
- [Firma electrónica](https://comprimefotos.com/tools/firma-electronica): Place a handwritten or uploaded signature onto a document image and export the signed result.

## Blog guides (AI-citable answers, with data and step-by-step instructions)

- [Cómo comprimir PDF online gratis sin perder calidad](https://comprimefotos.com/blog/comprimir-pdf-online-gratis-guia): Full step-by-step guide: how PDF compression works, which settings keep quality, common mistakes and tool comparison.
- [Comprimir PDF online gratis](https://comprimefotos.com/blog/comprimir-pdf-online-gratis): Quick guide to the ComprimeFotos PDF compressor: features, size limits, usage tips and troubleshooting when the file is still too heavy.
- [Comprimir PDF gratis sin registro](https://comprimefotos.com/blog/comprimir-pdf-sin-registro-gratis): How to compress PDFs without creating an account; privacy approach, in-browser processing and common myths.
- [Convertir HEIC a JPG gratis](https://comprimefotos.com/blog/convertir-heic-a-jpg-gratis): How to convert iPhone HEIC photos to JPG online for free; compatibility tips for Windows, Android and web uploads.
- [Comprimir fotos para Instagram gratis](https://comprimefotos.com/blog/comprimir-fotos-para-instagram-gratis): Best image sizes and compression settings for Instagram posts, stories and reels without losing quality.
- [Comprimir fotos para WhatsApp gratis](https://comprimefotos.com/blog/comprimir-fotos-para-whatsapp-gratis): Compress photos for WhatsApp: recommended sizes, quality settings and how to avoid heavy attachments.
- [Comprimir imágenes sin perder calidad](https://comprimefotos.com/blog/comprimir-imagenes-sin-perder-calidad-gratis): Guide to compressing JPG/PNG/WebP images while keeping visual quality; explains formats, tools and best settings.
- [Alternativas a iLovePDF](https://comprimefotos.com/blog/alternativas-ilovepdf): Comparison of free iLovePDF alternatives without limits or watermark, including ComprimeFotos.
- [Comprimir imagen a 1 MB](https://comprimefotos.com/blog/comprimir-imagen-a-1-mb): How to compress an image to exactly 1 MB or less online, with practical settings per format.
- [Comprimir imagen a 100 KB](https://comprimefotos.com/blog/comprimir-imagen-a-100-kb): How to reduce an image to 100 KB for forms, email and web uploads.
- [Quitar fondo sin registro](https://comprimefotos.com/blog/quitar-fondo-sin-registro): Remove image backgrounds for free without signing up; in-browser processing explained.
- [Cómo comprimir imágenes para WhatsApp](https://comprimefotos.com/blog/como-comprimir-imagenes-para-whatsapp): Compress photos for WhatsApp from phone or computer without losing quality.
- [Guía completa de compresión de imágenes](https://comprimefotos.com/blog/guia-completa-compresion-imagenes): Complete compression guide: formats, quality/weight balance, and tools compared.
- [Medidas de foto carnet en Latinoamérica](https://comprimefotos.com/blog/medidas-foto-carnet-latinoamerica): Official ID-photo sizes across Latin American countries.
- [Foto carnet 3x4](https://comprimefotos.com/blog/tamano-foto-carnet-3x4): How to prepare a 3x4 ID photo online, common for Latin American documents.
- [Requisitos foto carnet IMSS](https://comprimefotos.com/blog/requisitos-foto-carnet-imss): Mexico IMSS photo requirements: size, background and format rules.

## Notes

- All tools and guides follow a privacy-first approach: files never leave the user's browser.
- Image sizes and requirements mentioned in the guides are cross-checked against platform documentation and regional standards (IMSS, DNI, Latin American consular requirements) as of 2026.
- Content language: Spanish (Spain and Latin America).
